note: Campground at the Conley Bottom marina resort on Lake Cumberland near Monticello. The nightly sites fill a peninsula south of the marina with a swim beach at its tip; the full-hookup Sassafras loop sits below the main parking lot. Cable at the sites; restaurant, ship's store and boat rentals at the marina. No golf carts, ATVs, motorcycles or scooters. --Claude
summary: Kept. WATERFRONT UP not waterfront -> lakeview (the stored evidence and pin were on the seasonal ridge; the nightly peninsula's outer rows look over the cove past a thin tree line). Fees $29-51 (2027 posted: camper $29-44, full hookup $36-51); 50A/water, sewer at Sassafras; FCFS only; showers, laundry, dump, wifi. Pin move ~650 m. Google 4.7/1,030. Season not stated.
flags: WATERFRONT UP (not waterfront -> lakeview): the stored evidence describes the wooded NE ridge at the stored pin, which the resort map shows as seasonal sites along Cottage Road. The nightly campground is the peninsula south of the marina (36.9512,-84.8262). USGS 3DEP (lidar water 216.4 m; Lake Cumberland summer pool 723 ft = 220.4 m): the west-row pads (Catfish/Spoonbill side, e.g. 36.95089,-84.82737) are at 224.3 m and meet summer pool ~25 m out, behind a thin tree line, then open drawdown sand to the cove -> view, not lakefront (pads ~4 m up). The north-tip pad by the beach (36.95247,-84.82572, 222.7 m) is only ~2.3 m above summer pool at ~15 m over open ground, which could pass the kayak test, but the schematic map can't tie it to a site number (Sunfish 1-5 or Perch 1N are nearest the beach) and the resort sells no named sites (FCFS) -> left at lakeview by the default-down rule; reviewer may consider lakefront with a caveat. Replacement evidence: 'resort map + Esri/3DEP 2026-11-23: nightly peninsula at 36.9512,-84.8262; outer-row pads 222-225 m, 2-4 m above summer pool (220.4 m) at 15-25 m, thin tree line then open drawdown sand; lake visible -> lakeview; the stored ridge pin is the seasonal area.'

PIN MOVE ~650 m: stored 36.9559,-84.8217 is on the NE ridge (seasonal sites, per the 2024 resort map). Target: the nightly-site peninsula 36.9512,-84.8262 (bath house/dump at ~36.9510,-84.8262). Sassafras full-hookup loop is at ~36.9537,-84.8239.
